option.label: Ligule absent or a short hairy crown
option.detail: Inspect an intact inner collar. Gould says wanting or a short ciliate crown; absence in a damaged/unclear collar is not verified absence.

option.label: Usually 3–5 fingerlike, flexible or spreading branches
option.detail: Gould gives3–5, rarely6–7, digitate branches3.5–6cm, somewhat flexuous or spreading; tightly inserted spikelets appressed to rough/hirsute rachis.

option.label: Outer glumes hairless except rough midnerve
option.detail: Inspect the actual outer glumes. Rough midnerves are distinct from ordinary hairs and the dense cilia on the inner lower lemma.

option.label: Outer glume margins thin and translucent
option.detail: Gould describes hyaline margins of the narrowly lanceolate glumes; not the sheath margins or ligule.

option.label: LOWER fertile lemma flat, elliptic, strongly hairy edges/keel
option.detail: Gould lower lemma is strongly flattened and elliptic,1.8–2.8mm long; margins and keel strongly ciliate. These are not glume hairs.

option.label: LOWER fertile lemma awn 0.9–2.7 mm
option.detail: Measure the lower fertile lemma’s actual awn. Its range differs from the enclosing sterile floret’s0.9–1.4mm awn; do not interchange them.

option.label: Two STERILE florets above lower fertile floret
option.detail: One lower fertile plus two upper sterile florets equals three total in Gould. Supplementary accounts allow more; preserve source variation.

option.label: LOWER sterile floret truncate, hairless, encloses upper
option.detail: Lower means the lower of the TWO STERILE florets, above the fertile floret. Gould gives1.3–1.8mm, truncate, glabrous, enclosing the smaller upper sterile.

option.label: LOWER sterile floret awn 0.9–1.4 mm
option.detail: Measure the awn on the lower sterile floret, not the lower fertile lemma whose awn is0.9–2.7mm.

option.label: UPPER sterile floret smaller and awnless
option.detail: The uppermost sterile floret is similar but smaller and awnless. This does not make the lower sterile or lower fertile floret awnless.

learner_diagnostic_checks.look: Separate the outer glumes from the fringed inner lemma
learner_diagnostic_checks.check: Gould glumes are hairless except rough midnerves with translucent margins. The strongly ciliate margins and keel belong to the lower fertile lemma.
learner_diagnostic_checks.compare: Verified ordinary outer-glume hairs conflict with this account; a rough nerve, a hirsute rachis or inner lemma cilia do not.
learner_diagnostic_checks.certainty: Exact Gould327 historical Chloris ciliata, existing Stapfochloa ciliata crosswalk.

learner_diagnostic_checks.look: Trace all three florets and measure each awn separately
learner_diagnostic_checks.check: Lower fertile lemma awn0.9–2.7mm. Two sterile florets above it: lower sterile encloses upper and bears0.9–1.4mm awn; upper sterile is smaller and awnless.
learner_diagnostic_checks.compare: Do not call the whole spikelet awnless or treat the sterile range as fertile. Gould overlaps some KR awn readings, so length alone is not a decisive exclusion.
